notablePrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in their hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
